description:
The device management intents

TIP: Lists legacy template-based Endpoint security policies (intents): the Disk encryption, Antivirus, Firewall and Security baseline profiles created before Microsoft moved Endpoint security onto the Settings catalog. Each has displayName, description, templateId, isAssigned, isMigratingToConfigurationPolicy, roleScopeTagIds, lastModifiedDateTime. Use $expand=assignments to see target groups. An audit of Endpoint security must check both list-intents and list-configuration-policies. Supports $filter, $top, $skip, $select, $expand, $orderby, $count.
